   187	\begin{proof}[Proof of \Cref{thm:basis-test}]
   188	The question lengths and times of both the quantum low-degree test and the cross-check are given by
   189	\begin{equation*}
   190	m \log(q) = 2\cdot \left\lceil \frac{\log(n)}{\log(q)}\right\rceil  \cdot \log(q) = O(\log(n)).
   191	\end{equation*}
   192	As for the answer lengths and times, these are bounded by $\poly(n)$ for both the quantum low-degree test and the cross-check.
   193	We now consider the completeness and soundness cases separately.
   194	\paragraph{Completeness.}
   195	Let~$(\psi, M)$ be the value-$1$ commuting EPR strategy for the quantum low-degree test guaranteed by \Cref{thm:anand-thomas-low-degree}.
   196	This has state $\ket{\psi} = \ket{\mathrm{EPR}_q^n} \ket{\mathrm{EPR}_2}$ and measurement matrices $M^{W,w}_a = \tau^{W,w}_a \otimes I_{\reg{aux}}$.
   197	If we add in the measurement matrices $M^W_u = \tau^W_u \otimes I_{\reg{aux}}$,
   198	then this strategy passes the cross-check with probability~$1$.
   199	This is because after Player~$\bb$ measures~$\bu$,
   200	the state collapses to $\ket{\tau^{\bW}_{\bu}}\ket{\tau^{\bW}_{\bu}} \ket{\mathrm{EPR}_2}$,
   201	and so Player~$\overline{\bb}$ will measure $\ba = g_{\bu}(\bw)$.
   202	As a result, this is a value-$1$ strategy.
   203	Furthermore, it is a commuting EPR strategy because the cross-check measurements $M^W$ and $M^{W,w}$ commute.
   204	Finally, this strategy extends the Pauli basis strategy.
   205	This proves the completeness case.
   206	
   207	\paragraph{Soundness.}
   208	Throughout the soundness, we will use $\delta(\eps)$ to denote a function of the form $\poly(\eps, \eta)$ which may change from use to use.
   209	The $\delta(\eps)$ in \Cref{thm:anand-thomas-low-degree} is of this form because $d/q\leq \eta$.
   210	
   211	Let $\overline{\calS} = (\overline{\psi}, \overline{M})$ be a strategy with $\valstrat{\game_{\mathrm{basis}}}{\overline{\calS}} = 1-\eps$.
   212	Then this strategy must pass $\game_{\mathrm{Qlowdeg}}$ with probability at least $1-2\eps$.
   213	By \Cref{thm:anand-thomas-low-degree} this gives us a local isometry
   214	$\phi = \phi_{\mathrm{local}}\otimes \phi_{\mathrm{local}}$ and a state $\ket{\mathrm{aux}}$
   215	with the following properties:
   216	if we define the new strategy $\calS$
   217	in which $\ket{\psi} = \phi \ket{\overline{\psi}}$

   233	\approx_{\eps}
   234	I_{\reg{Alice}} \otimes M^{W,w}_a

    19	\section{At a glance}
    20	
    21	\begin{itemize}
    22	  \item \textbf{Difficulty.} Medium.  The operator estimate imported by the
    23	  source is plausible, but its stated two-variable polynomial contract is
    24	  contradicted by a two-dimensional example at every fixed positive input
    25	  consistency error.
    26	  \item \textbf{Estimated weight.} Correcting the scalar contract changes one
    27	  shared predicate.  Formalizing the resulting quantitative pasting estimate
    28	  is expected to require roughly 300--600 lines using the existing distance
    29	  calculus.
    30	  \item \textbf{Mathlib/project split.} The obstruction is elementary real
    31	  analysis and finite-dimensional measurement theory.  The repaired proof is
    32	  primarily project-local consistency and Cauchy--Schwarz calculus.
    33	  \item \textbf{Key mathematical inputs.} A positive real power tends to zero
    34	  at zero, while a fixed positive consistency error need not decrease with the
    35	  collision error.
    36	  The discrepancy is tracked in \ghissue{196}.
    37	\end{itemize}
    38	
    39	\section{Key theorem forms}
    40	
    41	The source asks for an error function
    42	$\delta_{\mathrm{pasting}}(\eta,\delta)$ satisfying
    43	\[
    44	  \delta_{\mathrm{pasting}}(\eta,\delta)
    45	    = \operatorname{poly}(\eta,\delta)
    46	\]
    47	and bounding the final consistency defect whenever the three input defects are
    48	at most $\delta$ and the codeword-collision probability is at most $\eta$.
    49	Under the paper's global convention, the displayed polynomial assertion means
    50	that there is a universal $C>0$ such that
    51	\[
    52	  0 \leq \delta_{\mathrm{pasting}}(\eta,\delta)
    53	    \leq C(\eta\delta)^C
    54	  \qquad (\eta,\delta>0).
    55	  \tag{product contract}
    56	\]
    57	The imported proof instead accumulates terms depending separately on the two
    58	errors, including $O(\delta^{1/2})$, $O((\delta+\eta)^{1/2})$, and $\eta$.
    59	A compatible corrected theorem form would use, for example, an upper bound by
    60	$A(\eta^r+\delta^s)$ for universal $A\geq1$ and $r,s>0$.
    61	
    62	\section{The source assertion}
    63	
    64	Lemma~\texttt{lem:pasting} of \cite[lines~504--525]{Ji2020MIPStar} imports
    65	Fact~4.35 from the NEEXP paper.  Its error is declared to be
    66	$\operatorname{poly}(\eta,\delta)$.  The asymptotic convention in
    67	\cite[lines~19--29]{Ji2020MIPStar} requires every variable to occur in the
    68	product on the right side of the product contract.  The proof of the imported
    69	fact, however, bounds the two sources of error independently; see
    70	\cite[lines~1030--1209]{Natarajan2018NEEXP}.%
    71	\footnote{The mirrored passages are
    72	\path{references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex}, lines~19--29;
    73	\path{references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex}, lines~504--525;
    74	and \path{references/neexp-paper/05_quantum_preliminaries.tex},
    75	lines~1030--1209.}
    76	
    77	\section{A two-dimensional counterexample}
    78	
    79	Fix $0<\rho<1$.  Let every question set, both codeword sets, and the second
    80	answer set be a singleton, and let the first answer set be $\{0,1\}$.  Use the
    81	point-mass question distribution and local Hilbert spaces $\C^2$.  In the
    82	standard basis, take the normalized bipartite state
    83	\[
    84	  \ket{\psi_\rho}
    85	    = \sqrt{1-\rho}\ket{0,0}+\sqrt{\rho}\ket{1,1}.
    86	\]
    87	Let both codeword measurements have their sole effect equal to the identity,
    88	and evaluate the sole first codeword to $0$.  Let the joint answer measurement
    89	be the standard-basis projective measurement: its effects at $(0,*)$ and
    90	$(1,*)$ are respectively $\ket{0}\!\bra{0}$ and $\ket{1}\!\bra{1}$.
    91	
    92	The second codeword set is a singleton, so its pairwise-collision hypothesis is
    93	vacuous for every $\eta\geq0$.  The second marginal is exactly consistent, and
    94	the perfectly correlated state makes the joint answer measurement exactly
    95	self-consistent.  The first marginal differs from the constantly-zero
    96	codeword answer precisely on the $\ket{1,1}$ component, so its consistency
    97	defect is $\rho$.  Consequently all hypotheses of the pasting lemma hold with
    98	$\delta=\rho$.
    99	
   100	The pasted measurement also has a single codeword outcome and its effect is the
   101	identity.  After evaluation it is deterministic at $(0,*)$, whereas the joint
   102	answer measurement returns $(1,*)$ with probability $\rho$.  Their final
   103	consistency defect is therefore $\rho$.  Thus the asserted conclusion would
   104	require
   105	\[
   106	  \rho \leq \delta_{\mathrm{pasting}}(\eta,\rho)
   107	  \qquad\text{for every }\eta>0.
   108	\]
   109	The product contract gives the opposite asymptotic bound
   110	$\delta_{\mathrm{pasting}}(\eta,\rho)\leq C(\eta\rho)^C$.  Since $C>0$, the
   111	right side tends to zero with $\eta$, which is a contradiction.  As $\rho$ can
   112	be arbitrarily small, this failure is not confined to the large-error boundary.
   113	
   114	\section{Comparison with the blueprint and formalization}
   115	
   116	The blueprint reproduces the source theorem and its unrestricted nonnegative
   117	error parameters.  The formal predicate implements the product contract
   118	literally, and the paper-facing pasting declaration retains the same theorem
   119	form.%

   124	The declaration must remain without a proof-complete blueprint marker until the
   125	scalar contract is corrected or the source theorem is restricted.  The
   126	operator-valued pasting construction itself is not refuted by this example.
   127	
   128	\section{Conclusion}
   129	
   130	The literal product-form interpretation of
   131	$\operatorname{poly}(\eta,\delta)$ makes the stated pasting lemma false.  This
   132	is a theorem-level scalar discrepancy, not a missing formal-library lemma.  The
   133	natural repair is to adopt a multivariate polynomial-smallness convention that
   134	allows separate positive powers of the input errors, matching the terms in the
   135	imported proof.  Adding an unadvertised coupling hypothesis between $\eta$ and
   136	$\delta$ would also avoid the counterexample, but would strengthen the source
   137	theorem and is therefore not the preferred repair.

+    (∑ b : β, stateQForm ψ

+      ∑ a : α, ∑ a' : α, if f a = f a' then
+        stateQForm ψ (heteroKron (A.effect a) (B.effect a')) else 0 := by

+      (heteroKron ((A.postprocess f).effect b) ((B.postprocess f).effect b)) =

+  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro a _
+  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro a' _

+      intro hpair

+      intro g _
+      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
+      intro g' _

+      _ = (Real.sqrt (opFamilyDistSq μ A B ψ) +
+          Real.sqrt (opFamilyDistSq μ B C ψ)) ^ 2 := by
+        change opFamilyDistSq μ A B ψ + opFamilyDistSq μ B C ψ +
+          2 * (Real.sqrt (opFamilyDistSq μ A B ψ) *
+            Real.sqrt (opFamilyDistSq μ B C ψ)) = _
+        have hAB := Real.sq_sqrt (DistanceCalculus.opFamilyDistSq_nonneg μ A B ψ)
+        have hBC := Real.sq_sqrt (DistanceCalculus.opFamilyDistSq_nonneg μ B C ψ)
+        nlinarith
+  calc
+    Real.sqrt (opFamilyDistSq μ A C ψ) ≤
+        Real.sqrt ((Real.sqrt (opFamilyDistSq μ A B ψ) +
+          Real.sqrt (opFamilyDistSq μ B C ψ)) ^ 2) :=
+      Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hdist
+    _ = |Real.sqrt (opFamilyDistSq μ A B ψ) +
+        Real.sqrt (opFamilyDistSq μ B C ψ)| := Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs _
+    _ = Real.sqrt (opFamilyDistSq μ A B ψ) +
+        Real.sqrt (opFamilyDistSq μ B C ψ) := by
+      rw [abs_of_nonneg (add_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))]
+
+/-- Coarsening the outcomes of a projective measurement preserves
+projectivity. -/
+private theorem postprocess_isProjective {α β ι : Type*}
+    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
+    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
+    (M : Measurement α ι) (hM : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M)
+    (f : α → β) : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (M.postprocess f) := by
+  classical
+  intro b
+  refine { isIdempotentElem := ?_, isSelfAdjoint := ?_ }
+  · change (M.postprocess f).effect b * (M.postprocess f).effect b =
+      (M.postprocess f).effect b
+    simp only [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect]
+    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
+    simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
+    calc
+      (∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => f a = b),
+          ∑ a' ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a' => f a' = b),
+            M.effect a * M.effect a') =
+          ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => f a = b),
+            ∑ a' ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a' => f a' = b),
+              if a' = a then M.effect a else 0 := by
+        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+        intro a _
+        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+        intro a' _
+        by_cases haa' : a' = a
+        · subst a'
+          simp [(hM a).isIdempotentElem.eq]
+        · rw [if_neg haa']
+          exact DistanceCalculus.projective_effect_mul_effect_eq_zero
+            M hM (Ne.symm haa')
+      _ = ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => f a = b), M.effect a := by
+        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+        intro a ha
+        simp [ha]
+  · change ((M.postprocess f).effect b)ᴴ = (M.postprocess f).effect b
+    exact
+      (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp ((M.postprocess f).pos b)).isHermitian.eq
+
+/-- Performing two outcome relabelings has the same effects as their
+composition. -/
+private theorem postprocess_postprocess_effect {α β γ ι : Type*}
+    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
+    [Fintype γ] [DecidableEq γ] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
+    (M : Measurement α ι) (f : α → β) (g : β → γ) (c : γ) :
+    ((M.postprocess f).postprocess g).effect c =
+      (M.postprocess (fun a => g (f a))).effect c := by
+  classical
+  simp only [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect, Finset.sum_filter]
+  calc
+    (∑ b : β, if g b = c then
+        ∑ a : α, if f a = b then M.effect a else 0 else 0) =
+        ∑ b : β, ∑ a : α,
+          if g b = c ∧ f a = b then M.effect a else 0 := by
+      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+      intro b _
+      by_cases hbc : g b = c <;> simp [hbc]
+    _ = ∑ a : α, ∑ b : β,
+        if g b = c ∧ f a = b then M.effect a else 0 := by
+      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
+    _ = ∑ a : α, if g (f a) = c then M.effect a else 0 := by
+      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+      intro a _
+      by_cases hac : g (f a) = c
+      · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (f a)]
+        · simp [hac]
+        · intro b _ hba
+          simp [Ne.symm hba]
+        · simp
+      · apply Eq.trans (Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun b _ => by
+          by_cases hab : f a = b
+          · subst b
+            simp [hac]
+          · simp [hab]))
+        simp [hac]
+    _ = ∑ a : α, if g (f a) = c then M.effect a else 0 := rfl
+
+/-- An injective relabeling does not merge the effect at a relabeled
+outcome. -/
+private theorem postprocess_effect_of_injective {α β ι : Type*}
+    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
+    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
+    (M : Measurement α ι) (f : α → β) (hf : Function.Injective f) (a : α) :
+    (M.postprocess f).effect (f a) = M.effect a := by
+  simp only [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect, Finset.sum_filter]
+  rw [Fintype.sum_eq_single a]
+  · simp
+  · intro z hza
+    rw [if_neg]
+    exact fun h => hza (hf h)
+
+/-- The squared effects of a POVM sum to at most the identity. -/
+private theorem measurement_sum_adjoint_mul_le_one {α ι : Type*}
+    [Fintype α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (M : Measurement α ι) :
+    ∑ a : α, (M.effect a)ᴴ * M.effect a ≤ 1 := by
+  calc
+    ∑ a : α, (M.effect a)ᴴ * M.effect a =
+        ∑ a : α, M.effect a * M.effect a := by
+      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+      intro a _
+      rw [DistanceCalculus.measurement_effect_hermitian]
+    _ ≤ ∑ a : α, M.effect a := by
+      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
+      intro a _
+      exact MIPStarRE.Quantum.sq_le_self (M.pos a)
+        (DistanceCalculus.measurement_effect_le_one M a)
+    _ = 1 := M.sum_eq_one
+
+/-- The equal-outcome part of the tensor product of two POVMs is bounded by
+the identity. -/
+private theorem matched_tensor_sum_le_one {α ιA ιB : Type*}
+    [Fintype α] [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA]
+    [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
+    (A : Measurement α ιA) (B : Measurement α ιB) :
+    ∑ a : α, heteroKron (A.effect a) (B.effect a) ≤ 1 := by
+  calc
+    ∑ a : α, heteroKron (A.effect a) (B.effect a) ≤
+        ∑ a : α, ∑ b : α, heteroKron (A.effect a) (B.effect b) := by
+      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
+      intro a _
+      exact Finset.single_le_sum
+        (fun b _ => MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg (A.pos a) (B.pos b))
+        (Finset.mem_univ a)
+    _ = 1 := by
+      ext i j
+      simp only [Matrix.sum_apply, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker,
+        Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply]
+      simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul]
+      rw [show (∑ a : α, A.effect a i.1 j.1) = (1 : Op ιA) i.1 j.1 by
+        simpa only [Matrix.sum_apply] using congrFun (congrFun A.sum_eq_one i.1) j.1]
+      rw [show (∑ b : α, B.effect b i.2 j.2) = (1 : Op ιB) i.2 j.2 by
+        simpa only [Matrix.sum_apply] using congrFun (congrFun B.sum_eq_one i.2) j.2]
+      exact congrFun (congrFun
+        (Matrix.one_kronecker_one (m := ιA) (n := ιB) (α := ℂ)) i) j
+
+/-- Multiplying every effect of a POVM on the left by a fixed projective
+effect preserves square-summability. -/
+private theorem projective_mul_measurement_sum_adjoint_mul_le_one
+    {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
+    (P : Op ι) (hP : IsProj P) (M : Measurement α ι) :
+    ∑ a : α, (P * M.effect a)ᴴ * (P * M.effect a) ≤ 1 := by
+  calc
+    ∑ a : α, (P * M.effect a)ᴴ * (P * M.effect a) =
+        ∑ a : α, (M.effect a)ᴴ * P * M.effect a := by
+      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+      intro a _
+      rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
+      rw [hP.isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq]
+      calc
+        (M.effect a)ᴴ * P * (P * M.effect a) =
+            (M.effect a)ᴴ * ((P * P) * M.effect a) := by
+          simp only [mul_assoc]
+        _ = (M.effect a)ᴴ * P * M.effect a := by
+          rw [hP.isIdempotentElem.eq]
+          exact (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
+    _ ≤ ∑ a : α, (M.effect a)ᴴ * M.effect a := by
+      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
+      intro a _
+      simpa [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using
+        star_left_conjugate_le_conjugate hP.le_one (M.effect a)
+    _ ≤ 1 := measurement_sum_adjoint_mul_le_one M
+
+/-- Tensoring two projectors gives a projector on the product space. -/
+private theorem heteroKron_isProj {ιA ιB : Type*}
+    [Fintype ιA] [Fintype ιB]
+    {P : Op ιA} {Q : Op ιB} (hP : IsProj P) (hQ : IsProj Q) :
+    IsProj (heteroKron P Q) := by
+  refine { isIdempotentElem := ?_, isSelfAdjoint := ?_ }
+  · change heteroKron P Q * heteroKron P Q = heteroKron P Q
+    rw [heteroKron_mul, hP.isIdempotentElem.eq, hQ.isIdempotentElem.eq]
+  · change (heteroKron P Q)ᴴ = heteroKron P Q
+    unfold heteroKron
+    simp only [Matrix.kronecker]
+    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_kronecker, hP.isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq,
+      hQ.isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq]
+
+/-- The squared effects in one fiber of a pair-valued measurement sum to at
+most the identity. -/
+private theorem measurement_pair_fiber_sum_adjoint_mul_le_one
+    {α β ι : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
+    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
+    (M : Measurement (α × β) ι) (a : α) :
+    ∑ b : β, (M.effect (a, b))ᴴ * M.effect (a, b) ≤ 1 := by
+  have hsquare (z : α × β) : (M.effect z)ᴴ * M.effect z ≤ M.effect z := by
+    rw [DistanceCalculus.measurement_effect_hermitian]
+    exact MIPStarRE.Quantum.sq_le_self (M.pos z)
+      (DistanceCalculus.measurement_effect_le_one M z)
+  calc
+    ∑ b : β, (M.effect (a, b))ᴴ * M.effect (a, b) ≤
+        ∑ b : β, M.effect (a, b) := by
+      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ => hsquare (a, b)
+    _ ≤ ∑ a' : α, ∑ b : β, M.effect (a', b) := by
+      exact Finset.single_le_sum
+        (fun a' _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun b _ => M.pos (a', b))
+        (Finset.mem_univ a)
+    _ = ∑ z : α × β, M.effect z := (Fintype.sum_prod_type _).symm
+    _ = 1 := M.sum_eq_one
+
+/-- A projective joint effect is selected exactly by the matching
+postprocessing fiber. -/
+private theorem postprocess_effect_mul_effect {α β ι : Type*}
+    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
+    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
+    (M : Measurement α ι) (hM : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M)
+    (f : α → β) (b : β) (a : α) :
+    (M.postprocess f).effect b * M.effect a =
+      if f a = b then M.effect a else 0 := by
+  classical
+  rw [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect, Finset.sum_mul]
+  calc
+    (∑ z ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun z => f z = b), M.effect z * M.effect a) =
+        ∑ z ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun z => f z = b),
+          if z = a then M.effect a else 0 := by
+      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+      intro z _
+      by_cases hza : z = a
+      · subst z
+        simp [(hM a).isIdempotentElem.eq]
+      · rw [if_neg hza]
+        exact DistanceCalculus.projective_effect_mul_effect_eq_zero M hM hza
+    _ = if f a = b then M.effect a else 0 := by simp
+
+/-- Right-handed form of `postprocess_effect_mul_effect`. -/
+private theorem effect_mul_postprocess_effect {α β ι : Type*}
+    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
+    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
+    (M : Measurement α ι) (hM : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M)
+    (f : α → β) (b : β) (a : α) :
+    M.effect a * (M.postprocess f).effect b =
+      if f a = b then M.effect a else 0 := by
+  have h := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose
+    (postprocess_effect_mul_effect M hM f b a)
+  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
+    DistanceCalculus.measurement_effect_hermitian M a,
+    DistanceCalculus.measurement_effect_hermitian (M.postprocess f) b] at h
+  by_cases hab : f a = b
+  · simpa [hab, DistanceCalculus.measurement_effect_hermitian M a] using h
+  · simpa [hab] using h
+
+/-- Two compatible marginals of a joint projective measurement multiply to
+the unique joint effect in their common fiber. -/
+private theorem postprocess_product_eq_effect {α β γ ι : Type*}
+    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
+    [Fintype γ] [DecidableEq γ] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
+    (M : Measurement α ι) (hM : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M)
+    (f : α → β) (g : α → γ) (a : α)
+    (hunique : ∀ z, f z = f a → g z = g a → z = a) :
+    (M.postprocess f).effect (f a) * (M.postprocess g).effect (g a) =
+      M.effect a := by
+  classical
+  rw [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect M g (g a), Finset.mul_sum]
+  calc
+    (∑ z ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun z => g z = g a),
+        (M.postprocess f).effect (f a) * M.effect z) =
+        ∑ z ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun z => g z = g a),
+          if f z = f a then M.effect z else 0 := by
+      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+      intro z _
+      exact postprocess_effect_mul_effect M hM f (f a) z
+    _ = M.effect a := by
+      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single a]
+      · simp
+      · intro z hz hza
+        rw [if_neg]
+        intro hzf
+        exact hza (hunique z hzf (Finset.mem_filter.mp hz).2)
+      · simp
+
+/-- Left multiplication contracts an operator-family distance when the
+multipliers are square-summable on every fiber of the outcome map. -/
+private theorem opFamilyDistSq_mul_fiber_le {X α Γ ι : Type*}
+    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype Γ] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
+    (μ : Distribution X) (A B : X → Measurement α ι)
+    (eval : Γ → X → α) (S : X → Γ → Op ι)
+    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (δ : ℝ)
+    (hS : ∀ x a,
+      (1 - ∑ z : Γ, if eval z x = a then (S x z)ᴴ * S x z else 0).PosSemidef)
+    (h : opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x a => (A x).effect a)
+      (fun x a => (B x).effect a) ψ ≤ δ) :
+    opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x z => S x z * (A x).effect (eval z x))
+      (fun x z => S x z * (B x).effect (eval z x)) ψ ≤ δ := by
+  classical
+  apply le_trans ?_ h
+  unfold opFamilyDistSq
+  apply avgOver_mono
+  intro x
+  rw [show (∑ z : Γ, ‖applyOperatorToState
+      (S x z * (A x).effect (eval z x) - S x z * (B x).effect (eval z x)) ψ‖ ^ 2) =
+      ∑ a : α, ∑ z ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun z => eval z x = a),
+        ‖applyOperatorToState
+          (S x z * ((A x).effect a - (B x).effect a)) ψ‖ ^ 2 by
+    calc
+      _ = ∑ a : α, ∑ z ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun z => eval z x = a),
+          ‖applyOperatorToState
+            (S x z * (A x).effect (eval z x) -
+              S x z * (B x).effect (eval z x)) ψ‖ ^ 2 :=
+        (Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ (fun z => eval z x) _).symm
+      _ = _ := by
+        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+        intro a _
+        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+        intro z hz
+        rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hz).2]
+        simp only [mul_sub]]
+  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
+  intro a _
+  have hcontract :
+      ∑ z : Γ, (if eval z x = a then S x z else 0)ᴴ *
+          (if eval z x = a then S x z else 0) ≤ 1 := by
+    calc
+      ∑ z : Γ, (if eval z x = a then S x z else 0)ᴴ *
+          (if eval z x = a then S x z else 0) =
+          ∑ z : Γ, if eval z x = a then (S x z)ᴴ * S x z else 0 := by
+        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+        intro z _
+        by_cases hza : eval z x = a <;> simp [hza]
+      _ ≤ 1 := Matrix.le_iff.mpr (hS x a)
+  have hmul := DistanceCalculus.sum_norm_mul_apply_le
+    (fun z : Γ => if eval z x = a then S x z else 0)
+    ((A x).effect a - (B x).effect a) ψ hcontract
+  calc
+    (∑ z ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun z => eval z x = a),
+        ‖applyOperatorToState
+          (S x z * ((A x).effect a - (B x).effect a)) ψ‖ ^ 2) =
+        ∑ z : Γ, if eval z x = a then
+          ‖applyOperatorToState
+            (S x z * ((A x).effect a - (B x).effect a)) ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0 := by
+      rw [Finset.sum_filter]
+    _ = ∑ z : Γ, ‖applyOperatorToState
+        ((if eval z x = a then S x z else 0) *
+          ((A x).effect a - (B x).effect a)) ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
+      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+      intro z _
+      by_cases hza : eval z x = a <;> simp [hza, applyOperatorToState]
+    _ ≤ ‖applyOperatorToState ((A x).effect a - (B x).effect a) ψ‖ ^ 2 := hmul
+
+set_option maxHeartbeats 400000 in
+-- The three-stage family comparison requires a larger elaboration budget.
+/-- Replacing the two outer copies and the inner marginal in a joint
+projective effect costs two outer distances and one inner distance. -/
+private theorem sqrt_opFamilyDistSq_joint_sandwich_le
+    {X α β ιA ιB : Type*}
+    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
+    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
+    (μ : Distribution X) (J : X → Measurement (α × β) ιA)
+    (G : X → Measurement α ιB) (P : X → Measurement β ιB)
+    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (q d : ℝ)
+    (hJ : ∀ x, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (J x))
+    (hG : ∀ x, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (G x))
+    (hq : opFamilyDistSq μ
+      (fun x a => heteroKron (((J x).postprocess Prod.fst).effect a) 1)
+      (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((G x).effect a)) ψ ≤ q)
+    (hd : opFamilyDistSq μ
+      (fun x b => heteroKron (((J x).postprocess Prod.snd).effect b) 1)
+      (fun x b => heteroKron 1 ((P x).effect b)) ψ ≤ d) :
+    Real.sqrt (opFamilyDistSq μ
+      (fun x ab => heteroKron ((J x).effect ab) 1)
+      (fun x ab => heteroKron 1
+        ((G x).effect ab.1 * (P x).effect ab.2 * (G x).effect ab.1)) ψ) ≤
+      2 * Real.sqrt q + Real.sqrt d := by
+  classical
+  let JA : X → Measurement α ιA := fun x => (J x).postprocess Prod.fst
+  let JB : X → Measurement β ιA := fun x => (J x).postprocess Prod.snd
+  let JL : X → Measurement (α × β) (ιA × ιB) := fun x =>
+    DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ιB) (J x)
+  let JAL : X → Measurement α (ιA × ιB) := fun x =>
+    DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ιB) (JA x)
+  let JBL : X → Measurement β (ιA × ιB) := fun x =>
+    DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ιB) (JB x)
+  let GR : X → Measurement α (ιA × ιB) := fun x =>
+    DistanceCalculus.rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := ιA) (G x)
+  let PR : X → Measurement β (ιA × ιB) := fun x =>
+    DistanceCalculus.rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := ιA) (P x)
+  let F₀ : X → (α × β) → Op (ιA × ιB) := fun x ab => (JL x).effect ab
+  let F₁ : X → (α × β) → Op (ιA × ιB) := fun x ab =>
+    ((GR x).effect ab.1 * (JAL x).effect ab.1) * (JBL x).effect ab.2
+  let F₂ : X → (α × β) → Op (ιA × ιB) := fun x ab =>
+    ((GR x).effect ab.1 * (JAL x).effect ab.1) * (PR x).effect ab.2
+  let F₃ : X → (α × β) → Op (ιA × ιB) := fun x ab =>
+    ((GR x).effect ab.1 * (PR x).effect ab.2) * (GR x).effect ab.1
+  have hq' : opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x a => (JAL x).effect a)
+      (fun x a => (GR x).effect a) ψ ≤ q := by
+    simpa [JAL, JA, GR, DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement,
+      DistanceCalculus.rightPlacedMeasurement,
+      MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne] using hq
+  have hd' : opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x b => (JBL x).effect b)
+      (fun x b => (PR x).effect b) ψ ≤ d := by
+    simpa [JBL, JB, PR, DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement,
+      DistanceCalculus.rightPlacedMeasurement,
+      MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne] using hd
+  have hS₀ (x : X) (a : α) :
+      (1 - ∑ ab : α × β, if ab.1 = a then
+        ((JL x).effect ab)ᴴ * (JL x).effect ab else 0).PosSemidef := by
+    apply Matrix.le_iff.mp
+    calc
+      (∑ ab : α × β, if ab.1 = a then
+          ((JL x).effect ab)ᴴ * (JL x).effect ab else 0) =
+          ∑ b : β, ((JL x).effect (a, b))ᴴ * (JL x).effect (a, b) := by
+        rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]

   449	      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
   450	    _ = 2 * (‖ψ‖ ^ 2 -
   451	          ∑ a : α, stateQForm ψ (A.effect a * B.effect a)) := by
   452	      rw [stateQForm_effect_sum A ψ, stateQForm_effect_sum B ψ]
   453	      ring
   454	    _ = _ := by rw [point_defect_eq A B ψ]

   456	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for the agreement facts (Facts 4.13 and
   457	4.14), item 2: projective measurements make distance exactly twice the
   458	pointwise defect. -/
   459	theorem point_distance_eq_two_defect_of_projective {α ι : Type*}
   460	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   461	    (A B : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α ι)
   462	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι)
   463	    (hA : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective A)
   464	    (hB : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective B) :
   465	    (∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState (A.effect a - B.effect a) ψ‖ ^ 2) =

465	    (∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState (A.effect a - B.effect a) ψ‖ ^ 2) =
   466	      2 * (∑ a : α, ∑ b : α,
   467	        if a = b then 0 else stateQForm ψ (A.effect a * B.effect b)) := by
   468	  calc
   469	    _ = ∑ a : α, (stateQForm ψ (A.effect a * A.effect a) +
   470	          stateQForm ψ (B.effect a * B.effect a) -
   471	          2 * stateQForm ψ (A.effect a * B.effect a)) := by
   472	      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   473	      intro a _
   474	      exact norm_effect_sub_effect_sq_expand A B ψ a
   475	    _ = ∑ a : α, (stateQForm ψ (A.effect a) + stateQForm ψ (B.effect a) -
   476	          2 * stateQForm ψ (A.effect a * B.effect a)) := by
   477	      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   478	      intro a _
   479	      rw [(hA a).isIdempotentElem.eq, (hB a).isIdempotentElem.eq]
   480	    _ = (∑ a : α, stateQForm ψ (A.effect a)) +
   481	          (∑ a : α, stateQForm ψ (B.effect a)) -
   482	          2 * (∑ a : α, stateQForm ψ (A.effect a * B.effect a)) := by
   483	      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]

   485	          ∑ a : α, stateQForm ψ (A.effect a * B.effect a)) := by
   486	      rw [stateQForm_effect_sum A ψ, stateQForm_effect_sum B ψ]
   487	      ring
   488	    _ = _ := by rw [point_defect_eq A B ψ]

   502	/-- A Hermitian left factor moves to the first slot of the vector inner product. -/
   503	private theorem stateQForm_mul_eq_re_inner_apply {ι : Type*}
   504	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   505	    (A B : Op ι) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (hA : Aᴴ = A) :
   506	    stateQForm ψ (A * B) =
   507	      (inner ℂ (applyOperatorToState A ψ)
   508	        (applyOperatorToState B ψ)).re := by
   509	  have hadjoint : (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A).adjoint =
   510	      Matrix.toEuclideanLin A := by
   511	    rw [← Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_eq_adjoint, hA]
   512	  calc
   513	    stateQForm ψ (A * B) =
   514	        (inner ℂ ψ
   515	          (applyOperatorToState A (applyOperatorToState B ψ))).re := by
   516	      rw [stateQForm, applyOperatorToState_mul]
   517	    _ = (inner ℂ ψ
   518	          ((Matrix.toEuclideanLin A).adjoint
   519	            (applyOperatorToState B ψ))).re := by
   520	      rw [hadjoint]
   521	      rfl
   522	    _ = _ := by
   523	      rw [LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]
   524	      rfl

   526	/-- With a projective left measurement, defect is an inner-product error sum. -/
   527	private theorem point_defect_eq_sum_inner_of_projective_left {α ι : Type*}
   528	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   529	    (A B : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α ι)
   530	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι)

   532	    (∑ a : α, ∑ b : α,
   533	      if a = b then 0 else stateQForm ψ (A.effect a * B.effect b)) =
   534	      ∑ a : α, (inner ℂ (applyOperatorToState (A.effect a) ψ)
   535	        (applyOperatorToState (A.effect a - B.effect a) ψ)).re := by
   536	  calc
   537	    _ = ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 - ∑ a : α,
   538	          stateQForm ψ (A.effect a * B.effect a) := point_defect_eq A B ψ

   540	          ∑ a : α, stateQForm ψ (A.effect a * B.effect a) := by
   541	      rw [stateQForm_effect_sum]
   542	    _ = ∑ a : α, (stateQForm ψ (A.effect a) -
   543	          stateQForm ψ (A.effect a * B.effect a)) := by

   546	          (A.effect a * (A.effect a - B.effect a)) := by
   547	      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   548	      intro a _
   549	      rw [mul_sub, stateQForm_sub, (hA a).isIdempotentElem.eq]
   550	    _ = _ := by
   551	      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   552	      intro a _
   553	      exact stateQForm_mul_eq_re_inner_apply _ _ ψ
   554	        (measurement_effect_hermitian A a)

   556	/-- Projective measurement components satisfy a Pythagorean norm identity. -/
   557	private theorem sum_norm_effect_apply_sq_of_projective {α ι : Type*}
   558	    [Fintype α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   559	    (A : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α ι)
   560	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι)
   561	    (hA : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective A) :
   562	    (∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState (A.effect a) ψ‖ ^ 2) = ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   563	  calc
   564	    _ = ∑ a : α, stateQForm ψ (A.effect a * A.effect a) := by
   565	      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   566	      intro a _
   567	      rw [norm_applyOperatorToState_sq_eq]
   568	      change stateQForm ψ ((A.effect a)ᴴ * A.effect a) = _
   569	      rw [measurement_effect_hermitian]

   571	      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   572	      intro a _

   576	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for the agreement facts (Facts 4.13 and
   577	4.14), item 3: pointwise projective-left defect obeys the Cauchy--Schwarz
   578	square-root bound. -/
   579	theorem abs_point_defect_le_sqrt_distance_of_projective_left {α ι : Type*}
   580	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   581	    (A B : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α ι)
   582	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1)
   583	    (hA : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective A) :
   584	    |∑ a : α, ∑ b : α,
   585	      if a = b then 0 else stateQForm ψ (A.effect a * B.effect b)| ≤
   586	      Real.sqrt (∑ a : α,
   587	        ‖applyOperatorToState (A.effect a - B.effect a) ψ‖ ^ 2) := by
   588	  rw [point_defect_eq_sum_inner_of_projective_left A B ψ hA]
   589	  let u : α → EuclideanSpace ℂ ι := fun a =>
   590	    applyOperatorToState (A.effect a) ψ
   591	  let v : α → EuclideanSpace ℂ ι := fun a =>
   592	    applyOperatorToState (A.effect a - B.effect a) ψ
   593	  calc
   594	    |∑ a : α, (inner ℂ (u a) (v a)).re| ≤
   595	        ∑ a : α, |(inner ℂ (u a) (v a)).re| :=
   596	      Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
   597	    _ ≤ ∑ a : α, ‖u a‖ * ‖v a‖ := by
   598	      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
   599	      intro a _
   600	      exact (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans (norm_inner_le_norm (u a) (v a))
   601	    _ ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ a : α, ‖u a‖ ^ 2) *
   602	          Real.sqrt (∑ a : α, ‖v a‖ ^ 2) := by
   603	      simpa using Real.sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt
   604	        (Finset.univ : Finset α) (fun a => ‖u a‖) (fun a => ‖v a‖)
   605	    _ = Real.sqrt (∑ a : α,
   606	          ‖applyOperatorToState (A.effect a - B.effect a) ψ‖ ^ 2) := by
   607	      rw [show (∑ a : α, ‖u a‖ ^ 2) = ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 by
   608	        simpa [u] using sum_norm_effect_apply_sq_of_projective A ψ hA]
   609	      rw [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg ψ), hψ]
   610	      simp [v]

   612	/-- Regard a unit Euclidean vector as an LDT pure state. -/
   613	private noncomputable def pureStateOfUnitVector {ι : Type*}
   614	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
   615	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1) : PureState ι where
   616	  vector := ψ.ofLp
   617	  unit := by
   618	    calc
   619	      star ψ.ofLp ⬝ᵥ ψ.ofLp = ψ.ofLp ⬝ᵥ star ψ.ofLp := dotProduct_comm _ _
   620	      _ = inner ℂ ψ ψ := (EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct ψ ψ).symm
   621	      _ = (‖ψ‖ ^ 2 : ℂ) := inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K ψ
   622	      _ = 1 := by rw [hψ]; norm_num

   624	/-- For a unit vector, `stateQForm` agrees with the LDT pure-state expectation. -/
   625	private theorem stateQForm_eq_ev {ι : Type*}
   626	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
   627	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1) (T : Op ι) :
   628	    stateQForm ψ T = ev (pureStateOfUnitVector ψ hψ : QuantumState ι) T := by
   629	  rw [PureState.ev_eq_re_inner]
   630	  simp only [pureStateOfUnitVector]
   631	  change (inner ℂ ψ (WithLp.toLp 2 (T *ᵥ ψ.ofLp))).re =
   632	    (star ψ.ofLp ⬝ᵥ T *ᵥ ψ.ofLp).re
   633	  rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct, dotProduct_comm]

   635	/-- Pure-state evaluation of `Tᴴ T` is the squared norm of `T ψ`. -/
   636	private theorem ev_adjoint_mul_self_eq_norm_sq {ι : Type*}
   637	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
   638	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1) (T : Op ι) :
   639	    ev (pureStateOfUnitVector ψ hψ : QuantumState ι) (Tᴴ * T) =

   642	  exact (norm_applyOperatorToState_sq_eq T ψ).symm

   644	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for Proposition 4.29: operator-family
   645	distance controls the change in diagonal overlap. -/
   646	theorem overlap_gap_le_of_opFamilyDistSq {X α ι : Type*}
   647	    [Fintype α]
   648	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
   649	    (μ : Distribution X)
   650	    (A B D : X → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α ι)
   651	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (hμ : μ.IsProbability) (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1)
   652	    (ζ : ℝ)
   653	    (hBD : opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x a => (B x).effect a)
   654	      (fun x a => (D x).effect a) ψ ≤ ζ) :
   655	    |avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * (B x).effect a)) -
   656	      avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a, stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * (D x).effect a))| ≤
   657	        Real.sqrt ζ := by
   658	  classical
   659	  let ψp : PureState ι := pureStateOfUnitVector ψ hψ
   660	  let H : FiniteHilbertSpace :=
   661	    { carrier := ι
   662	      instFintype := inferInstance
   663	      instDecidableEq := inferInstance
   664	      instNonempty := inferInstance }
   665	  let As : X → SubMeas α ι := fun x =>
   666	    (MatrixMeasurement.toMeasurement (H := H) (A x)).toSubMeas
   667	  let Bs : X → SubMeas α ι := fun x =>
   668	    (MatrixMeasurement.toMeasurement (H := H) (B x)).toSubMeas
   669	  let Ds : X → SubMeas α ι := fun x =>
   670	    (MatrixMeasurement.toMeasurement (H := H) (D x)).toSubMeas
   671	  have hmass : ∑ x ∈ μ.support, μ.weight x ≤ 1 := by
   672	    rw [hμ.weight_sum_eq_one]
   673	  have hsdd : SDDRel (ψp : QuantumState ι) μ Bs Ds ζ := by
   674	    constructor
   675	    unfold sddError qSDD qSDDCore
   676	    calc
   677	      avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a, ev (ψp : QuantumState ι)
   678	          (((Bs x).outcome a - (Ds x).outcome a)ᴴ *
   679	            ((Bs x).outcome a - (Ds x).outcome a))) =
   680	          opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x a => (B x).effect a)
   681	            (fun x a => (D x).effect a) ψ := by
   682	        unfold opFamilyDistSq
   683	        apply avgOver_congr
   684	        intro x
   685	        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   686	        intro a _
   687	        simpa [ψp, Bs, Ds, H] using
   688	          ev_adjoint_mul_self_eq_norm_sq ψ hψ ((B x).effect a - (D x).effect a)
   689	      _ ≤ ζ := hBD
   690	  have hgap := MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.easyApproxFromApproxDelta
   691	    (ψp : QuantumState ι) ψp.toQuantumState_isNormalized μ hmass Bs Ds As ζ hsdd
   692	  have hBA : avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a,
   693	      ev (ψp : QuantumState ι) ((A x).effect a * (B x).effect a)) =
   694	      avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a,
   695	        ev (ψp : QuantumState ι) ((B x).effect a * (A x).effect a)) := by
   696	    apply avgOver_congr
   697	    intro x
   698	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   699	    intro a _
   700	    exact ev_mul_comm_of_psd _ _ _ ((A x).pos a) ((B x).pos a)
   701	  have hDA : avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a,
   702	      ev (ψp : QuantumState ι) ((A x).effect a * (D x).effect a)) =
   703	      avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a,
   704	        ev (ψp : QuantumState ι) ((D x).effect a * (A x).effect a)) := by
   705	    apply avgOver_congr
   706	    intro x
   707	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   708	    intro a _
   709	    exact ev_mul_comm_of_psd _ _ _ ((A x).pos a) ((D x).pos a)
   710	  rw [show avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a,
   711	      stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * (B x).effect a)) =
   712	      avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a,
   713	        ev (ψp : QuantumState ι) ((A x).effect a * (B x).effect a)) by
   714	    apply avgOver_congr
   715	    intro x
   716	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   717	    intro a _
   718	    exact stateQForm_eq_ev ψ hψ _]
   719	  rw [show avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a,
   720	      stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * (D x).effect a)) =
   721	      avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a,
   722	        ev (ψp : QuantumState ι) ((A x).effect a * (D x).effect a)) by
   723	    apply avgOver_congr
   724	    intro x
   725	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   726	    intro a _
   727	    exact stateQForm_eq_ev ψ hψ _]
   728	  rw [hBA, hDA]
   729	  simpa only [ψp, As, Bs, Ds, H,
   730	    MatrixMeasurement.toMeasurement_outcome] using hgap

   732	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for Proposition 4.29: on a unit state and
   733	probability distribution, defect is one minus diagonal overlap. -/
   734	theorem consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap {X α ι : Type*}
   735	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   736	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   737	    (μ : Distribution X) (A B : X → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α ι)
   738	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (hμ : μ.IsProbability) (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1) :
   739	    consistencyDefect μ (fun x a => (A x).effect a)
   740	        (fun x a => (B x).effect a) ψ =
   741	      1 - avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a,
   742	        stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * (B x).effect a)) := by
   743	  unfold consistencyDefect
   744	  simp_rw [consistency_term_eq_stateQForm]

   748	      avgOver μ (fun x => ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 - ∑ a,
   749	        stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * (B x).effect a)) := by
   750	      apply avgOver_congr
   751	      intro x
   752	      exact point_defect_eq (A x) (B x) ψ
   753	    _ = avgOver μ (fun _ => ‖ψ‖ ^ 2) - avgOver μ (fun x => ∑ a,
   754	        stateQForm ψ ((A x).effect a * (B x).effect a)) :=
   755	      avgOver_sub μ _ _
   756	    _ = _ := by
   757	      rw [avgOver_const_of_isProbability μ hμ, hψ]
   758	      norm_num

    18	/-- The off-diagonal defect in `def:consistency`, blueprint
    19	`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:195-208`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:232-248`. -/
    20	noncomputable def consistencyDefect {X α ι : Type*}
    21	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    22	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    23	    (μ : Distribution X) (A B : X → α → Op ι)
    24	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) : ℝ :=
    25	  avgOver μ (fun x =>
    26	    ∑ a : α, ∑ b : α,
    27	      if a = b then 0 else
    28	        (inner ℂ ψ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv ι ℂ).symm
    29	          ((A x a * B x b).mulVec ψ))).re)

    31	/-- The quantitative relation in `def:consistency`, blueprint
    32	`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:195-208`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:232-248`. -/
    33	def IsConsistentWithin {X α ι : Type*}
    34	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    35	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    36	    (μ : Distribution X) (A B : X → α → Op ι)
    37	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (δ : ℝ) : Prop :=
    38	  consistencyDefect μ A B ψ ≤ δ

    40	/-- Unit-alphabet specialization of `def:povm-distance`, blueprint
    41	`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:219-226`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:258-271`. -/
    42	noncomputable def opDistSq {X ι : Type*}
    43	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    44	    (μ : Distribution X) (M N : X → Op ι) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) : ℝ :=
    45	  opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x (_ : Unit) => M x) (fun x (_ : Unit) => N x) ψ
    46	
    47	/-- The unit-alphabet operator distance equals its one-outcome family form from
    48	`def:povm-distance`, blueprint `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:219-226`, paper
    49	`06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:258-271`. -/
    50	theorem opDistSq_eq_opFamilyDistSq {X ι : Type*}
    51	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

    18	/-- The off-diagonal defect in `def:consistency`, blueprint
    19	`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:195-208`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:232-248`. -/
    20	noncomputable def consistencyDefect {X α ι : Type*}
    21	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    22	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    23	    (μ : Distribution X) (A B : X → α → Op ι)
    24	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) : ℝ :=
    25	  avgOver μ (fun x =>
    26	    ∑ a : α, ∑ b : α,
    27	      if a = b then 0 else
    28	        (inner ℂ ψ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv ι ℂ).symm
    29	          ((A x a * B x b).mulVec ψ))).re)
    30	
    31	/-- The quantitative relation in `def:consistency`, blueprint
    32	`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:195-208`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:232-248`. -/

    34	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    35	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    36	    (μ : Distribution X) (A B : X → α → Op ι)
    37	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (δ : ℝ) : Prop :=
    38	  consistencyDefect μ A B ψ ≤ δ

    41	`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:219-226`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:258-271`. -/

    45	  opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x (_ : Unit) => M x) (fun x (_ : Unit) => N x) ψ
    46	
    47	/-- The unit-alphabet operator distance equals its one-outcome family form from
    48	`def:povm-distance`, blueprint `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:219-226`, paper
    49	`06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:258-271`. -/
    50	theorem opDistSq_eq_opFamilyDistSq {X ι : Type*}
    51	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    52	    (μ : Distribution X) (M N : X → Op ι) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
    53	    opDistSq μ M N ψ = opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x (_ : Unit) => M x)
    54	      (fun x (_ : Unit) => N x) ψ := rfl

    57	local Hilbert spaces are identified, and both measurement distances are
    58	evaluated on the first strategy's state. Blueprint
    59	`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:228-237`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:273-285`. -/
    60	structure AreCloseStrategies (G : Game) (S S' : Strategy G) (δ : ℝ) : Prop where
    61	  /-- Identification of Alice's local Hilbert spaces. -/
    62	  hA : S.ιA = S'.ιA
    63	  /-- Identification of Bob's local Hilbert spaces. -/

    65	  state : stateDistSq S.ψ (reindexState

    67	  alice : opFamilyDistSq (G.μ.map Prod.fst)
    68	      (fun x a => heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) 1)
    69	      (fun x a => heteroKron (reindexOp (Equiv.cast hA) ((S'.A x).effect a)) 1)

    72	      (fun y b => heteroKron 1 ((S.B y).effect b))
    73	      (fun y b => heteroKron 1 (reindexOp (Equiv.cast hB) ((S'.B y).effect b)))

    25	/-- Formalization-only definition used in the proof of Fact 4.26: place a
    26	complete measurement on the left tensor factor. -/
    27	noncomputable def leftPlacedMeasurement {α ιA ιB : Type*}
    28	    [Fintype α] [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA]
    29	    [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
    30	    (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α ιA) :
    31	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α (ιA × ιB) :=
    32	  MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    33	    (fun a => heteroKron (M.effect a) 1)
    34	    (fun a => MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg (M.pos a)
    35	      (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg : 0 ≤ (1 : Op ιB)))
    36	    (by
    37	      change ∑ a : α, leftTensor (ι₂ := ιB) (M.effect a) = 1
    38	      rw [leftTensor_finset_sum, M.sum_eq_one, leftTensor_one])

    40	/-- Formalization-only definition used in the proof of Fact 4.26: place a
    41	complete measurement on the right tensor factor. -/
    42	noncomputable def rightPlacedMeasurement {α ιA ιB : Type*}
    43	    [Fintype α] [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA]
    44	    [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
    45	    (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α ιB) :
    46	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α (ιA × ιB) :=
    47	  MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    48	    (fun a => heteroKron 1 (M.effect a))
    49	    (fun a => MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg
    50	      (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg : 0 ≤ (1 : Op ιA)) (M.pos a))
    51	    (by
    52	      change ∑ a : α, rightTensor (ι₁ := ιA) (M.effect a) = 1
    53	      rw [rightTensor_finset_sum, M.sum_eq_one, rightTensor_one])

    66	/-- The (possibly unnormalized) rank-one state associated to a Euclidean vector. -/

    76	/-- Evaluation in the rank-one vector state is the corresponding quadratic form. -/
    77	private theorem vectorQuantumState_ev_eq_stateQForm {ι : Type*}
    78	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]

    98	theorem diagonal_postprocess_stateQForm_ge {α β ιA ιB : Type*}

   101	    [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   102	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB))
   103	    (A : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α ιA)
   104	    (B : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α ιB) (f : α → β) :
   105	    (∑ b : β, stateQForm ψ
   106	        (heteroKron ((A.postprocess f).effect b) ((B.postprocess f).effect b))) ≥
   107	      ∑ a : α, stateQForm ψ (heteroKron (A.effect a) (B.effect a)) := by
   108	  classical
   109	  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty (ιA × ιB) with
   110	  | inl hι =>
   111	      letI := hι
   112	      have hψ : ψ = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
   113	      subst ψ
   114	      simp [stateQForm, applyOperatorToState]
   115	  | inr hι =>
   116	      letI := hι
   117	      letI : Nonempty ιA := ⟨(Classical.choice hι).1⟩
   118	      letI : Nonempty ιB := ⟨(Classical.choice hι).2⟩
   119	      let HA : FiniteHilbertSpace :=
   120	        { carrier := ιA
   121	          instFintype := inferInstance
   122	          instDecidableEq := inferInstance
   123	          instNonempty := inferInstance }

   125	        { carrier := ιB
   126	          instFintype := inferInstance
   127	          instDecidableEq := inferInstance
   128	          instNonempty := inferInstance }

   130	        (MatrixMeasurement.toMeasurement (H := HA) A).toSubMeas

   132	        (MatrixMeasurement.toMeasurement (H := HB) B).toSubMeas

   141	          MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect]
   142	        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   143	        intro a _
   144	        exact hAoutcome a
   145	      have hBpost (b : β) :
   146	          (MIPStarRE.LDT.postprocess Bs f).outcome b =
   147	            (B.postprocess f).effect b := by
   148	        rw [SubMeas.postprocess_outcome,
   149	          MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect]
   150	        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   151	        intro a _
   152	        exact hBoutcome a
   153	      have h := MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.qMatchMass_leftRight_postprocess_ge
   154	        (vectorQuantumState ψ) As Bs f
   155	      unfold qMatchMass at h
   156	      simp only [leftPlacedSubMeas_outcome, rightPlacedSubMeas_outcome] at h
   157	      simpa only [hAoutcome, hBoutcome, hApost, hBpost,
   158	        leftTensor_mul_rightTensor_eq_opTensor,
   159	        vectorQuantumState_ev_eq_stateQForm, MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron] using h

   161	/-- Squared effects in one measurement fiber sum to at most the identity. -/
   162	private theorem measurement_fiber_sum_adjoint_mul_le_one {α β ι : Type*}
   163	    [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   164	    (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (α × β) ι) (a : α) :
   165	    ∑ b : β, (M.effect (a, b))ᴴ * M.effect (a, b) ≤ 1 := by
   166	  classical
   167	  have hsquare_le (z : α × β) :
   168	      (M.effect z)ᴴ * M.effect z ≤ M.effect z := by
   169	    rw [measurement_effect_hermitian M z]
   170	    exact MIPStarRE.Quantum.sq_le_self (M.pos z) (measurement_effect_le_one M z)
   171	  calc
   172	    ∑ b : β, (M.effect (a, b))ᴴ * M.effect (a, b) ≤
   173	        ∑ b : β, M.effect (a, b) :=
   174	      Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ => hsquare_le (a, b)
   175	    _ ≤ ∑ a' : α, ∑ b : β, M.effect (a', b) :=
   176	      Finset.single_le_sum
   177	        (fun a' _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun b _ => M.pos (a', b))
   178	        (Finset.mem_univ a)
   179	    _ = ∑ z : α × β, M.effect z := (Fintype.sum_prod_type _).symm
   180	    _ = 1 := M.sum_eq_one

   188	    (1 - ∑ b : β, (leftTensor (ι₂ := ιB) (M.effect (a, b)))ᴴ *
   189	      leftTensor (ι₂ := ιB) (M.effect (a, b))).PosSemidef := by
   190	  apply Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp

   193	    ∑ b : β, (leftTensor (ι₂ := ιB) (M.effect (a, b)))ᴴ *
   194	          leftTensor (ι₂ := ιB) (M.effect (a, b)) =
   195	        ∑ b : β, leftTensor (ι₂ := ιB)

   204	      leftTensor_mono (measurement_fiber_sum_adjoint_mul_le_one M a)

docs/reports/issue-930-session48-distribution-audit.md:58:Lean repairs this by defining `distinctTupleDistribution params k` as a finite-support weight for every `k` (`Pasting/Defs/Tuples.lean:23-36`).  The general theorem only proves total mass at most `1` (`Pasting/Defs/Tuples.lean:38-67`).  The exact probability statement is separated as `distinctTupleDistribution_weight_sum_eq_one_of_le`, which assumes `k <= params.q` (`Pasting/BridgeLemmas/Common.lean:311-343`).
docs/reports/issue-930-session48-distribution-audit.md:60:The formal `ldDnoteq` comparison handles both cases.  If `k <= q`, it follows the paper's collision-probability argument.  If `k > q`, the distinct support is empty; the formal total variation between the uniform tuple distribution and the zero distinct-tuple weight is `1/2`, and this is bounded by `k^2/q` because `k > q` (`Pasting/Core.lean:561-805`).  The averaging helper `avgOver_distinct_bounded_le_avgOver_uniform_add_tv_of_any_k` propagates the same convention to bounded nonnegative functions (`Pasting/BridgeLemmas/LineInterpolation/Averaging.lean:286-318`).

/-- The sandwiched simultaneous-measurement estimate of `lem:ld-sandwich`.
One universal asymptotic constant applies independently of the distribution,
measurements, state, and error parameters. Blueprint
`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:454-480`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:465-501`. -/
theorem consistencyDefect_sandwich_le :
    ∃ C₀ : ℝ, 1 ≤ C₀ ∧
      ∀ {k : ℕ} {X Y ιA ιB : Type*} {R Γ : Fin k → Type*}
        [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y] [Nonempty Y]
        [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
        [∀ i, Fintype (R i)] [∀ i, DecidableEq (R i)]
        [∀ i, Fintype (Γ i)] [∀ i, DecidableEq (Γ i)]
        (μ : Distribution X)
        (eval : (i : Fin k) → Γ i → Y → R i)
        (G : (i : Fin k) → X → Measurement (Γ i) ιB)
        (A : X → Measurement ((i : Fin k) → Γ i) ιA)
        (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (ε δ : ℝ),
      μ.IsProbability → ‖ψ‖ = 1 → 0 < ε → 0 ≤ δ →
      (∀ i x, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (G i x)) →
      (∀ x, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (A x)) →
      (∀ i (g g' : Γ i), g ≠ g' →
        avgOver (uniformDistribution Y)
          (fun y => if eval i g y = eval i g' y then 1 else 0) ≤ ε) →
      (∀ i, consistencyDefect (Distribution.prod μ (uniformDistribution Y))
        (fun xy a => heteroKron (((A xy.1).postprocess
          (fun g => eval i (g i) xy.2)).effect a) 1)
        (fun xy a => heteroKron 1 (((G i xy.1).postprocess
          (fun g => eval i g xy.2)).effect a)) ψ ≤ δ) →
      consistencyDefect (Distribution.prod μ (uniformDistribution Y))
        (fun xy a => heteroKron (((A xy.1).postprocess
          (evalFunctionTuple eval xy.2)).effect a) 1)
        (fun xy a => heteroKron 1 (∑ g : (i : Fin k) → Γ i,
          if evalFunctionTuple eval xy.2 g = a then
            sandwichProduct (fun i x h => (G i x).effect h) xy.1 g else 0)) ψ ≤
        C₀ * (k : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (δ + ε) := by
  sorry

/-- The positive-mass conditional collision bound used by `lem:pasting`.
This is a formalization-only spelling of the conditional probability in
`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:517-546`, with paper origin
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:504-525`. -/
def HasConditionalCollisionBound {X Y₁ Y₂ R₂ Γ₂ : Type*}
    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype Y₁] [DecidableEq Y₁]
    [Fintype Y₂] [DecidableEq Y₂] [Fintype R₂] [DecidableEq R₂]
    [Fintype Γ₂]
    (D : Distribution ((X × Y₁) × Y₂)) (eval₂ : Γ₂ → Y₂ → R₂)
    (η : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ x y₁, 0 < (D.map Prod.fst).weight (x, y₁) →
    ∀ g g' : Γ₂, g ≠ g' →
      (∑ y₂ : Y₂, D.weight ((x, y₁), y₂) *
        if eval₂ g y₂ = eval₂ g' y₂ then 1 else 0) ≤
        η * (D.map Prod.fst).weight (x, y₁)

/-- The effects obtained by sandwiching one measurement with a projective
measurement form a POVM. This is `lem:pasting-measurement`, the measurement
assertion for `eq:pasting-2a`; blueprint `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:548-567`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:514-524`. -/
theorem pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement {Γ₁ Γ₂ ι : Type*}
    [Fintype Γ₁] [Fintype Γ₂] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (G₁ : Measurement Γ₁ ι) (G₂ : Measurement Γ₂ ι)
    (hG₂ : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective G₂) :
    (∀ g : Γ₁ × Γ₂,
      0 ≤ pastedMeasurement G₁.effect G₂.effect g.1 g.2) ∧
      (∑ g : Γ₁ × Γ₂,
        pastedMeasurement G₁.effect G₂.effect g.1 g.2) = 1 := by
  constructor
  · intro g
    unfold pastedMeasurement
    apply Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr
    have hpos : ((G₂.effect g.2)ᴴ * G₁.effect g.1 * G₂.effect g.2).PosSemidef :=
      (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (G₁.pos g.1)).conjTranspose_mul_mul_same
        (G₂.effect g.2)
    rw [MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.measurement_effect_hermitian G₂ g.2] at hpos
    exact hpos
  · classical
    unfold pastedMeasurement
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.sum_comm]
    calc
      (∑ g₂ : Γ₂, ∑ g₁ : Γ₁,
          G₂.effect g₂ * G₁.effect g₁ * G₂.effect g₂) =
          ∑ g₂ : Γ₂,
            G₂.effect g₂ * (∑ g₁ : Γ₁, G₁.effect g₁) * G₂.effect g₂ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro g₂ _
        rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
      _ = ∑ g₂ : Γ₂, G₂.effect g₂ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro g₂ _
        rw [G₁.sum_eq_one, mul_one, (hG₂ g₂).isIdempotentElem.eq]
      _ = 1 := G₂.sum_eq_one

/-- Pasting two consistent measurements yields a product-form polynomial
error. All operator families in the conclusion are the postprocessed source
families. This is `lem:pasting`, blueprint `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:517-546`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:504-525`. -/
theorem exists_pasting_error :
    ∃ δp : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, IsPolyErr₂ δp ∧
      ∀ {X Y₁ Y₂ R₁ R₂ Γ₁ Γ₂ ι : Type*}
        [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype Y₁] [DecidableEq Y₁]
        [Fintype Y₂] [DecidableEq Y₂] [Fintype R₁] [DecidableEq R₁]
        [Fintype R₂] [DecidableEq R₂]
        [Fintype Γ₁] [DecidableEq Γ₁] [Fintype Γ₂] [DecidableEq Γ₂]
        [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
        (D : Distribution ((X × Y₁) × Y₂))
        (eval₁ : Γ₁ → Y₁ → R₁) (eval₂ : Γ₂ → Y₂ → R₂)
        (G₁ : X → Measurement Γ₁ ι) (G₂ : X → Measurement Γ₂ ι)
        (A : ((X × Y₁) × Y₂) → Measurement (R₁ × R₂) ι)
        (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ι × ι)) (η δ : ℝ),
        D.IsProbability → ‖ψ‖ = 1 → 0 ≤ η → 0 ≤ δ →
        (∀ x, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (G₂ x)) →
        (∀ q, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (A q)) →
        HasConditionalCollisionBound D eval₂ η →
        consistencyDefect D
          (fun q a₁ => heteroKron (((A q).postprocess Prod.fst).effect a₁) 1)
          (fun q a₁ => heteroKron 1 (((G₁ q.1.1).postprocess
            (fun g => eval₁ g q.1.2)).effect a₁)) ψ ≤ δ →
        consistencyDefect D
          (fun q a₂ => heteroKron (((A q).postprocess Prod.snd).effect a₂) 1)
          (fun q a₂ => heteroKron 1 (((G₂ q.1.1).postprocess
            (fun g => eval₂ g q.2)).effect a₂)) ψ ≤ δ →
        consistencyDefect D (fun q a => heteroKron ((A q).effect a) 1)
          (fun q a => heteroKron 1 ((A q).effect a)) ψ ≤ δ →
        consistencyDefect D (fun q a => heteroKron ((A q).effect a) 1)
          (fun q a => heteroKron 1 (∑ g₁ : Γ₁, ∑ g₂ : Γ₂,
            if (eval₁ g₁ q.1.2, eval₂ g₂ q.2) = a then
              pastedMeasurement (fun g => (G₁ q.1.1).effect g)
                (fun g => (G₂ q.1.1).effect g) g₁ g₂ else 0)) ψ ≤ δp η δ := by
  sorry

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

import MIPStarRE.LDT.Basic.ParametersBase

/-! # Polynomial error predicates

Shared quantitative predicates for the polynomial-error bounds in QPBT
chapters 12, 14, and 15.

## References

These are formalization-only auxiliaries for polynomially small QPBT error
functions. The one-parameter form includes the explicit square-root witnesses
in paper chapter 14; the two-parameter form is used by `lem:pasting` in paper
chapter 6.
-/

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-- A nonnegative one-parameter error function bounded by a positive real power.

**Local fix:** The prefactor and exponent are quantified separately. Paper
chapter 14 explicitly obtains `sqrt ε` at
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:508-520,649-676`, which the coupled
constant in the shorthand at `04_preliminaries.tex:26-29` cannot bound on all
positive inputs. The correction is documented in
`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_polynomial-error-square-root.tex` and tracked by issue
#16. -/
def IsPolyErr (f : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ C r : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ 0 < r ∧ ∀ x, 0 ≤ x →
    0 ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ C * Real.rpow x r

/-- The two-parameter polynomial bound used by `lem:pasting`: on positive
arguments, one universal positive constant is both the prefactor and exponent.
This is the convention of `04_preliminaries.tex:26-29`, applied at
`06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:518-524`; blueprint
`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:442-469`. -/
def IsPolyErr₂ (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ x y, 0 < x → 0 < y →
    0 ≤ f x y ∧ f x y ≤ C * Real.rpow (x * y) C

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

## Statement integrity

For `consistencyDefect_sandwich_le`, the paper and Lean both assume normalized state data, projective codeword and joint measurements, codeword collision at most `ε`, and marginal consistency defect at most `δ`. Lean additionally exposes finite/decidable instances and sign/normalization conditions. The paper concludes an `O(k √(δ+ε))` bound; Lean proves `8k√(δ+ε)`. Verdict: **faithful boundary hypotheses**.

For `exists_pasting_error`, the Lean statement exactly transcribes the paper’s product-form two-variable polynomial error. Verdict: **exact**, but inconsistent: fixing `δ = ρ > 0` in the documented example forces `ρ ≤ C(ηρ)^C` for every `η > 0`, which fails as `η → 0`.

## Open obligations

`exists_pasting_error` is the sole remaining `sorry`. No theorem can discharge it under the current `IsPolyErr₂` definition. Resolution requires a source-level decision, most naturally restoring an additive multivariate error contract such as `C(η^r + δ^s)` before formalizing the pasting estimate.

## Handoff

Review the recursive sandwich replacement argument first, then the counterexample establishing why the second acceptance target cannot be proved as stated. The next session should be a source-realignment decision followed by a prover session once the scalar error contract is corrected.

/-! # Polynomial error predicates

Shared quantitative predicates for the polynomial-error bounds in QPBT
chapters 12, 14, and 15.

## References

These are formalization-only auxiliaries for polynomially small QPBT error
functions. The one-parameter form includes the explicit square-root witnesses
in paper chapter 14; the two-parameter form is used by `lem:pasting` in paper
chapter 6.
-/

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-- A nonnegative one-parameter error function bounded by a positive real power.

**Local fix:** The prefactor and exponent are quantified separately. Paper
chapter 14 explicitly obtains `sqrt ε` at
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:508-520,649-676`, which the coupled
constant in the shorthand at `04_preliminaries.tex:26-29` cannot bound on all
positive inputs. The correction is documented in
`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_polynomial-error-square-root.tex` and tracked by issue
#16. -/
def IsPolyErr (f : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ C r : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ 0 < r ∧ ∀ x, 0 ≤ x →
    0 ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ C * Real.rpow x r

/-- The two-parameter polynomial bound used by `lem:pasting`: on positive
arguments, one universal positive constant is both the prefactor and exponent.
This is the convention of `04_preliminaries.tex:26-29`, applied at
`06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:518-524`; blueprint
`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:517-546`. -/
def IsPolyErr₂ (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ x y, 0 < x → 0 < y →
    0 ≤ f x y ∧ f x y ≤ C * Real.rpow (x * y) C

\begin{lemma}[Fact 4.35 in~\cite{NW19}]\label{lem:pasting}
Let $\mathcal{D}$ be a distribution on $(x,y_1,y_2)\in \mathcal{X}\times \mathcal{Y}_1\times \mathcal{Y}_2$. For $i\in \{1,2\}$ let $\mathcal{G}_i$ be a collection of functions $g_i: \mathcal{Y}_i \to \mathcal{R}_i$ and let $\{(G_i)^{x}_{g}\}_{g\in \mathcal{G}_i}$ be families of measurements such that $\{(G_2)^x_g\}_g$ is projective for every $x$. Suppose further that for every $(x,y_1)$ it holds that for $g_2\neq g'_2 \in \mathcal{G}_2$ the probability, on average over $y_2$ chosen from $\mathcal{D}$ conditioned on $(x,y_1)$, that $g_2(y_2)=g'_2(y_2)$  is at most $\eta$. 
Let $\{A^{x,y_1,y_2}_{a_1,a_2}\}$ be a family of projective measurements with outcomes $(a_1,a_2)\in \mathcal{R}_1 \times \mathcal{R}_2$ such that for $i\in \{1,2\}$,
\begin{equation}\label{eq:pasting-1}
 A^{x,y_1,y_2}_{a_i} \otimes \Id \simeq_\delta \Id \otimes (G_i)^x_{[\eval_{y_i}(\cdot)=a_i]}
\end{equation}
and 
\begin{equation}\label{eq:pasting-2}
 A^{x,y_1,y_2}_{a_1,a_2} \otimes \Id \simeq_\delta \Id \otimes  A^{x,y_1,y_2}_{a_1,a_2}\;.
\end{equation}
Define a family of measurements $\{J^x_{g_1,g_2}\}$ as
\begin{equation}\label{eq:pasting-2a}
 J^x_{g_1,g_2} \,=\, (G_2)^x_{g_2} (G_1)^x_{g_1} (G_2)^x_{g_2}\;.
\end{equation}
Then there is a 
\begin{equation}\label{eq:def-deltap}
\delta_{pasting} \,=\, \delta_{pasting}(\eta,\delta)\,=\, \poly(\eta,\delta)
\end{equation} such that 
\begin{equation}\label{eq:pasting-3}
 A^{x,y_1,y_2}_{a_1,a_2} \otimes \Id \simeq_{\delta_{pasting}} \Id \otimes J^x_{[\eval_{y_1}(\cdot)=a_1,\eval_{y_2}(\cdot) = a_2]}\;.
\end{equation}
\end{lemma}





\begin{lemma}[Fact~4.32 of \cite{NW19}]
  \label{lem:close-strategies-have-close-values}
  Let $\game$ be a nonlocal game, and let $\strategy, \strategy'$ be
  two strategies that are $\delta$-close (in the sense of
  \Cref{def:strategy-distance}) for $\delta \in [0,1]$, and use the
  same state $\ket{\psi}$. If either $\strategy$ or $\strategy'$ is
  projective, then $|\val^*(\game,\strategy) - \val^*(\game,
  \strategy')| \leq O(\delta^{1/2})$.
\end{lemma}

The complexity class $\MIP^*$ of \emph{multi-prover interactive proof
  systems with entangled provers} is the class of languages that can be
decided by a \emph{proof system} in which a polynomial-time classical
\emph{verifier} interacts with noncommunicating, computationally unbounded
 \emph{provers} who may share a \emph{finite-dimensional} entangled state. In general there may be polynomially many provers,
and the verifier may interact with them over polynomially many

/-! # Polynomial error predicates

Shared quantitative predicates for the polynomial-error bounds in QPBT
chapters 12, 14, and 15.

## References

These are formalization-only auxiliaries for the `poly` notation in
`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:402-427`, with paper origin
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:504-525`.
-/

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-- The one-parameter polynomial-smallness convention used by `lem:pasting`
and QPBT chapters 14--15; blueprint `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:402-427`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:504-525`. -/
def IsPolyErr (f : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ C r : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ 0 < r ∧ ∀ x, 0 ≤ x →
    0 ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ C * Real.rpow x r

/-- The two-parameter polynomial-smallness convention used by `lem:pasting`
and QPBT chapter 15; blueprint `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:402-427`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:504-525`. -/
def IsPolyErr2 (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ C r s : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ 0 < r ∧ 0 < s ∧ ∀ x y, 0 ≤ x → 0 ≤ y →
    0 ≤ f x y ∧
      f x y ≤ C * (Real.rpow x r + Real.rpow y s)

/-- Unicode compatibility alias for the two-parameter polynomial-smallness
predicate used by `lem:pasting`, blueprint `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:402-427`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:504-525`. -/
abbrev IsPolyErr₂ := IsPolyErr2

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

Since the measurement $\{G^{i,\,x}_g\}$ is indexed by $g \in \mathcal G_i$, the operator $G^{k,\,x}_{g_1}$ is undefined whenever $\mathcal G_1 \ne \mathcal G_k$, so the printed pairing is a typographical slip. /-- The square root of the average squared operator distance satisfies the
ordinary triangle inequality. -/
private theorem sqrt_opFamilyDistSq_triangle {X α ι : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (μ : Distribution X) (A B C : X → α → Op ι)
    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
    Real.sqrt (opFamilyDistSq μ A C ψ) ≤
      Real.sqrt (opFamilyDistSq μ A B ψ) +
        Real.sqrt (opFamilyDistSq μ B C ψ) := by
  let u : X → α → EuclideanSpace ℂ ι := fun x a =>
    applyOperatorToState (A x a - B x a) ψ
  let v : X → α → EuclideanSpace ℂ ι := fun x a =>
    applyOperatorToState (B x a - C x a) ψ
  have hpoint (x : X) (a : α) :
      ‖applyOperatorToState (A x a - C x a) ψ‖ ^ 2 ≤

/-- Coarsening the outcomes of a projective measurement preserves
projectivity. -/
private theorem postprocess_isProjective {α β ι : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (M : Measurement α ι) (hM : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M)
    (f : α → β) : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (M.postprocess f) := by
  classical
  intro b
  refine { isIdempotentElem := ?_, isSelfAdjoint := ?_ }
  · show (M.postprocess f).effect b * (M.postprocess f).effect b =
      (M.postprocess f).effect b
    simp only [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect]
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    calc
      (∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => f a = b),
          ∑ a' ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a' => f a' = b),
            M.effect a * M.effect a') =
          ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => f a = b),
            ∑ a' ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a' => f a' = b),
              if a' = a then M.effect a else 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro a _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro a' _
        by_cases haa' : a' = a
        · subst a'
          simp [(hM a).isIdempotentElem.eq]
        · rw [if_neg haa']
          exact DistanceCalculus.projective_effect_mul_effect_eq_zero
            M hM (Ne.symm haa')
      _ = ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => f a = b), M.effect a := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro a ha
        simp [ha]
  · show ((M.postprocess f).effect b)ᴴ = (M.postprocess f).effect b
    exact
      (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp ((M.postprocess f).pos b)).isHermitian.eq

/-- Performing two outcome relabelings has the same effects as their
composition. -/
private theorem postprocess_postprocess_effect {α β γ ι : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
    [Fintype γ] [DecidableEq γ] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (M : Measurement α ι) (f : α → β) (g : β → γ) (c : γ) :
    ((M.postprocess f).postprocess g).effect c =
      (M.postprocess (fun a => g (f a))).effect c := by
  classical
  simp only [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect, Finset.sum_filter]
  calc
    (∑ b : β, if g b = c then
        ∑ a : α, if f a = b then M.effect a else 0 else 0) =
        ∑ b : β, ∑ a : α,
          if g b = c ∧ f a = b then M.effect a else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro b _
      by_cases hbc : g b = c <;> simp [hbc]
    _ = ∑ a : α, ∑ b : β,
        if g b = c ∧ f a = b then M.effect a else 0 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    _ = ∑ a : α, if g (f a) = c then M.effect a else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a _
      by_cases hac : g (f a) = c
      · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (f a)]
        · simp [hac]
        · intro b _ hba
          simp [Ne.symm hba]
        · simp
      · apply Eq.trans (Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun b _ => by
          by_cases hab : f a = b
          · subst b
            simp [hac]
          · simp [hab]))
        simp [hac]
    _ = ∑ a : α, if g (f a) = c then M.effect a else 0 := rfl
